answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 7103 Country: United Kingdom Title: In hadith theres a mention near meaning that black dogs are Shaitan will it be permissible to kill black and other Dogs? Q2-In Islam will it be permissible to kill Pigs? Q3-If Pigs touches a persons clothes or body will it become Napaak? please reply with refrence. Question: Q1-In hadith theres a mention near meaning that black dogs are Shaitan will it be permissible to kill black and other Dogs? Q2-In Islam will it be permissible to kill Pigs? Q3-If Pigs touches a persons clothes or body will it become Napaak? please reply with refrence. Answer ID: 7103 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 813/813=M/1429) One can kill the black and other dogs if they are rapacious and harm people, otherwise not. (1) They should not be killed needlessly. (2) The cloth and body does not get impure if it is touched by dry pig and there is no impression of impurity. But, it the pig is wet, then it is necessary to wash the place which is affected by its wetness. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
